test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

Immediate __relocation__ is your best course of action.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Migration**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Relocation **means the action of moving to a new place and establishing one's home or business there. (पुनर्वास)

 
 
• **For example- ***The dam construction project will require the relocation of a whole community.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Migration **is the process of a person or people travelling to a new place or country, usually in order to find work and live there temporarily or permanently. (प्रवास)
 
 
• **For example- ***It was the biggest migration of people seen in Europe since the Dark Ages.*
 
 
 
• Hence, it is clear that 'migration' is a synonym of 'relocation.'

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Emergence **means coming into view or becoming known. (सामने आना या ज्ञात होना)
 
• **Ending **means coming to a conclusion or finishing. (किसी निष्कर्ष पर पहुँचना या समाप्त करना)
 
• **Expiration **means coming to an end or reaching the end of a period of time. (किसी समय की समाप्ति पर पहुँचना)
